summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: R5 vs R6 table: the plan "adds AR-027..AR-035"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: The P0 plan adds 7 requirements: AR-027, AR-028, AR-029, AR-030, AR-031, AR-034 and AR-035. AR-032 and AR-033 stay P1 (DEC-R6-005) and are not among the 115.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: R7 item 3: attesting through approving GitHub reviews means "the 26 process requirements can verify"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: The evidence does not support this. AR-019-O3 is expected not to verify (DEC-R6-011, D-02). AR-005, AR-008-O2, AR-012-O2 and AR-024 also need dependency-decision, owner-approval or scope-change records, and events.jsonl has none (only work.* events). AR-034 depends on G7 closures that cannot close for this candidate.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: "One test weakening (UI-034-O2) … is in its tag changes, so it does not count"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: It does not count only in the plan verifier. The ledger verifier counts UI-034 as PASS, and the same holds for WDL-001 and AR-014, whose tests were also tag-changed. The ledger's 70 PASS includes all three. The weakening also breaks the WORK-PLAN rule "Never edit or delete existing tests to make them pass".

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: The final review "re-verified" R6-D-001 and reviewed candidate 46d5e11
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: The final review ran its reproductions and spot checks on 02c37d1 and carried them over to 46d5e11. It restarted on C2 at 01:10:14 and finished at 01:11:44. At review time the candidate's CI run 40798638092 was pending and candidate.deployed was null. The summary does not disclose this.
summaryDiscrepancies.files: docs/r6/reviews/final-review.json (candidate, restartedAtC2, finishedAt); FINAL-REVIEW.md "What carries over"

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: D-13: "the final review and disposition were attested in chat", with the final review implied to be of 46d5e11
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: DEVIATIONS.md D-13 says "The final independent review of 02c37d1", but final-review.json has candidateSha 46d5e11. The source records disagree with each other.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: R6-D-003: "151 POSTs in 60 s for one change"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: progress.json records a different measurement: about 5,000 failed POSTs per tab in 4-5 minutes. The summary reports only the final-review figure.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: "Open critical defects (G6 …)"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: G6 failed because the "live" producer failed: UI-006-O1/O4 live, DCT-LIVE-A and 8 live .NET tests, including the D-09 token and fixture-scan failures. R6-D-002 (AR-035-O4) failed in the browser producer, which is G5, G8 and G9.
summaryDiscrepancies.files: bundle/ledger.json gates; bundle/evidence/gates/G5.json, G6.json; live job log

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: "26 NOT_RUN requirements, mostly AR-*"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: All 26 are AR-*.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: Obligations (plan verifier): 89 FAIL
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: The number is correct, but 64 of the 89 have bound tests that passed. They are FAIL only because a sibling obligation's failure made their requirement evidence invalid. 24 have failing tests, and 1 (AR-035-O5) is producer-only. The summary does not explain this.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: "Was evidence manufactured …? No"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: The candidate's acceptance/defect-classes.json marks all 8 classes PASS, citing R5 fix SHAs absent from R6 history and reviewer evidence files that do not exist in the tree (acceptance/reviews/R5-*.md). These are carried-over PASS claims without evidence. The verifier rejects them, but the summary frames the issue only as a missed re-review.

summaryDiscrepancies.summaryClaim: The final review closed R1-F-1 "(23ac222)"
summaryDiscrepancies.evidence: final-review.json closure for R1-F-1 cites Adapter.syncFor and reproductions, not a commit. 23ac222 comes from progress.json. This is a minor sourcing gap, not a contradiction.
